This is the exhaustive command and argument inventory for the checked-in
`agent-libos` parser. For task-oriented explanations and security semantics,
use the [CLI Guide](cli.md). Defaults shown here are parser defaults; effective
Runtime settings may additionally come from `DEFAULT_CONFIG`, `config.yaml`, or
an explicit `--config` overlay as described in the
[Configuration Guide](configuration.md). For flags that store a constant
(including inverse-named flags such as `--optional` and `--flag/--no-flag`
pairs sharing one destination), the Default column shows `name=value`: the
parser destination the flag writes and that destination's effective value when
the flag is absent; passing the flag stores the flag's constant instead.
Usage wrapping and metavars are normalized across supported Python versions;
every accepted option alias is listed in the Arguments tables.

## `agent-libos`

```text
usage: agent-libos [-h] [--config CONFIG] [--db DB] [--module-manifest MODULE_MANIFEST]
                   [--trusted-module TRUSTED_MODULE]
                   [--trusted-module-sha256 TRUSTED_MODULE_SHA256]
                   {init,demo,audit,explain,llm-calls,payload-retention,processes,resources,tools,workflow,object-task,task-run,spawn,cd,exec,exit,llm-once,run,message,interrupt,checkpoint,skills,capabilities,images,jsonrpc,mcp,modules,human,semantic,store} ...
```

### Arguments

| Syntax | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `-h, --help` | no | — | show this help message and exit |
| `--config CONFIG` | no | `None` | YAML config overlay. Defaults to the project-root config.yaml when present. |
| `--db DB` | no | `None` | Runtime store target. 'user' uses the persistent per-user SQLite store; paths use file SQLite; 'local', ':memory:', and a bare 'sqlite://' use in-memory SQLite; a 'sqlite://' URI with a path selects that SQLite file; postgresql:// DSNs use PostgreSQL. If omitted, uses the selected config runtime store settings (default 'user' is persistent SQLite). |
| `--module-manifest MODULE_MANIFEST` | no | `[]` | Trusted startup module manifest to load before the runtime is used. May be passed multiple times. |
| `--trusted-module TRUSTED_MODULE` | no | `[]` | Trusted startup module entry in the form '<module_id>:<manifest_sha256>:<source_sha256>'. Use the trust_key from `modules verify`. |
| `--trusted-module-sha256 TRUSTED_MODULE_SHA256` | no | `[]` | Trusted startup module digest pair in the form '<manifest_sha256>:<source_sha256>', regardless of module id. Intended for local development only. |

### Subcommands

| Command | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `init` | Initialize a runtime database |
| `demo` | Run the deterministic coding-agent demo |
| `audit` | Print audit trace |
| `explain` | Explain protected operations from explicit runtime evidence |
| `llm-calls` | Print persisted LLM call records |
| `payload-retention` | Preview or apply one bounded LLM/effect payload-retention page |
| `processes` | Print process table |
| `resources` | Print process resource budget and usage |
| `tools` | Print registered tools |
| `workflow` | Run an Image-bound workflow tool directly without an LLM turn |
| `object-task` | Start, get, list, cancel, wait for, or watch Object tasks |
| `task-run` | Create, supervise, recover, or rerun a durable TaskRun |
| `spawn` | Spawn a process |
| `cd` | Set an AgentProcess working directory |
| `exec` | Exec an AgentProcess into another image |
| `exit` | Exit an AgentProcess |
| `llm-once` | Run one LLM quantum for a process |
| `run` | Run runnable processes with the LLM scheduler |
| `message` | Send a human process message |
| `interrupt` | Send a human interrupt process message |
| `checkpoint` | Create, list, inspect, diff, restore, fork, or replay checkpoints |
| `skills` | Discover, inspect, validate, register, trust, untrust, activate, or unload skills |
| `capabilities` | List, inspect, grant, delegate, revoke, or explain capabilities |
| `images` | List, inspect, validate, register, or commit AgentImages |
| `jsonrpc` | Register, list, inspect, call, or unregister JSON-RPC over HTTP endpoints |
| `mcp` | Operate MCP Tools and Host-only 2026-07-28 Resources, Prompts, OAuth, Elicitation, Tasks, subscriptions, and manifest DX |
| `modules` | List, inspect, or verify startup runtime modules |
| `human` | Process pending human messages in terminal order |
| `semantic` | Inspect semantic policy, FlowGraph, and settlement evidence |
| `store` | Perform explicit offline Runtime store administration |

## `agent-libos payload-retention`

```text
usage: agent-libos payload-retention [-h] {llm_call,external_effect} [--apply]
                                     [--limit LIMIT]
                                     [--after-created-at AFTER_CREATED_AT]
                                     [--after-record-id AFTER_RECORD_ID] [--actor ACTOR]
                                     [--correlation-id CORRELATION_ID]
```

### Arguments

| Syntax | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `-h, --help` | no | — | show this help message and exit |
| `{llm_call,external_effect}` | yes | `None` | Which bounded payload-retention page kind to preview or apply. |
| `--apply` | no | `apply=False` | Apply the page; the default is a non-mutating dry run. |
| `--limit LIMIT` | no | `None` | Maximum rows in the page; bounded by the policy hard limit. |
| `--after-created-at AFTER_CREATED_AT` | no | `None` | Opaque keyset cursor: created-at timestamp from the preceding page. |
| `--after-record-id AFTER_RECORD_ID` | no | `None` | Opaque keyset cursor: record id from the preceding page. |
| `--actor ACTOR` | no | `'host.retention'` | Actor recorded for the retention operation; defaults to host.retention. |
| `--correlation-id CORRELATION_ID` | no | `None` | Correlation id recorded for the retention operation. |

| `--working-directory WORKING_DIRECTORY` | no | `None` | Optional AgentProcess working directory. |
| `--authority-manifest-json AUTHORITY_MANIFEST_JSON` | no | `None` | Host/workflow-controller TaskAuthorityManifest template as a JSON object. Omit to permit controller-derived launch authority; an explicit '{}' suppresses it. |

## `agent-libos object-task start`

```text
usage: agent-libos object-task start [-h] --pid PID
                                     (--owner-oid OWNER_OID | --owner-name OWNER_NAME)
                                     [--namespace NAMESPACE] tool
                                     [--args-json ARGS_JSON] [--notify-pid NOTIFY_PID]
                                     [--notify-kind {normal,interrupt}]
                                     [--notify-channel NOTIFY_CHANNEL] [--watch-owner]
                                     [--watch-events WATCH_EVENTS]
                                     [--watch-channel WATCH_CHANNEL]
                                     [--watch-kind {normal,interrupt}]
                                     [--grant-result-to-notify] --wait
                                     [--timeout TIMEOUT]
```

### Arguments

| Syntax | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `-h, --help` | no | — | show this help message and exit |
| `--pid PID` | yes | `None` | Creator process id. |
| `--owner-oid OWNER_OID` | no | `None` | Owner object id. |
| `--owner-name OWNER_NAME` | no | `None` | Owner object name in the selected namespace. |
| `--namespace NAMESPACE` | no | `None` | Namespace for --owner-name. |
| `tool` | yes | `None` | Tool bound in the creator's complete process tool table. |
| `--args-json ARGS_JSON` | no | `'{}'` | JSON object passed as tool arguments. |
| `--notify-pid NOTIFY_PID` | no | `None` | Process to notify; defaults to --pid. |
| `--notify-kind {normal,interrupt}` | no | `'normal'` | — |
| `--notify-channel NOTIFY_CHANNEL` | no | `None` | Process-message channel; defaults to object-task. |
| `--watch-owner` | no | `watch_owner=False` | Notify the runner process when the owner object is updated or linked. |
| `--watch-events WATCH_EVENTS` | no | `[]` | Owner events to watch, comma-separated or repeated. Defaults to updated,linked when --watch-owner is set. |
| `--watch-channel WATCH_CHANNEL` | no | `None` | Runner message channel for owner-watch notices; defaults to object-task-owner. |
| `--watch-kind {normal,interrupt}` | no | `'normal'` | — |
| `--grant-result-to-notify` | no | `grant_result_to_notify=False` | Try to grant result read authority to notify pid; requires object grant authority. |
| `--wait` | yes | `wait=False` | Required by the one-shot CLI; wait until the task reaches a terminal or explicit waiting state before printing. |
| `--timeout TIMEOUT` | no | `None` | Optional wait timeout in seconds. |

## `agent-libos task-run`

```text
usage: agent-libos task-run [-h]
                            {start,get,list,wait,recovery-options,pause,resume,cancel,follow-up,recover,rerun} ...
```

### Arguments

| Syntax | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `-h, --help` | no | — | show this help message and exit |

### Subcommands

| Command | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `start` | Create a queued durable TaskRun; use --run to consume scheduler quanta now |
| `get` | Get the current durable TaskRun summary |
| `list` | List durable TaskRuns as a keyset-paginated page |
| `wait` | Observe a TaskRun until its revision changes, it blocks, or it is terminal |
| `recovery-options` | List the server-derived recovery options currently allowed for a TaskRun |
| `pause` | Durably pause a TaskRun before new dispatch |
| `resume` | Resume a paused TaskRun |
| `cancel` | Cancel a TaskRun with explicit confirmation |
| `follow-up` | Append a durable requirement and notify the current root Agent |
| `recover` | Apply a server-provided recovery option with explicit confirmation |
| `rerun` | Create a new TaskRun linked to a terminal source run |

## `agent-libos task-run start`

```text
usage: agent-libos task-run start [-h] (--goal GOAL | --goal-json GOAL_JSON)
                                  --title TITLE [--image IMAGE]
                                  [--launch-json LAUNCH_JSON]
                                  [--authority-manifest-id AUTHORITY_MANIFEST_ID]
                                  [--deadline-at DEADLINE_AT]
                                  [--retention {purge_on_terminal,permanent}]
                                  [--client-request-id CLIENT_REQUEST_ID] [--run]
                                  [--run-command-id RUN_COMMAND_ID]
                                  [--max-quanta MAX_QUANTA]
```

### Arguments

| Syntax | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `-h, --help` | no | — | show this help message and exit |
| `--goal GOAL` | no | `None` | Task goal as text. |
| `--goal-json GOAL_JSON` | no | `None` | Task goal as strict JSON. |
| `--title, --display-title TITLE` | yes | `None` | Persistent display title for the run. |
| `--image, --image-id IMAGE` | no | `None` | AgentImage id; omitted uses the Runtime's configured default image. |
| `--launch-json, --launch-options-json LAUNCH_JSON` | no | `'{}'` | Host-authored launch options as a strict JSON object. |
| `--authority-manifest-id, --authority-ref AUTHORITY_MANIFEST_ID` | no | `None` | Reference to an existing Host-authored authority manifest. |
| `--deadline-at DEADLINE_AT` | no | `None` | Optional absolute wall-clock deadline timestamp. |
| `--retention {purge_on_terminal,permanent}` | no | `'purge_on_terminal'` | Durable payload retention policy; permanent is Host/admin only. |
| `--client-request-id CLIENT_REQUEST_ID` | no | `None` | Stable client request id for create idempotency; omitted generates one. |
| `--run` | no | `run=False` | After creation, run until the run blocks, finishes, or exhausts --max-quanta. |
| `--run-command-id RUN_COMMAND_ID` | no | `None` | Stable command id for the separate --run mutation. |
| `--max-quanta MAX_QUANTA` | no | `None` | Optional scheduler quantum budget used only with --run. |

## `agent-libos task-run list`

usage: agent-libos task-run list [-h] [--status STATUSES] [--cursor CURSOR]

| Syntax | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `-h, --help` | no | — | show this help message and exit |
| `--status STATUSES` | no | `[]` | Filter status, comma-separated or repeated. Valid values: queued, running, waiting_human, waiting_process, waiting_message, waiting_tool, paused, cancelling, finalizing, needs_attention, succeeded, failed, cancelled. |
| `--cursor CURSOR` | no | `None` | Opaque keyset cursor from the preceding page. |
| `--limit LIMIT` | no | `100` | Page size from 1 through 500. |

## `agent-libos exec`

```text
usage: agent-libos exec [-h] image goal --pid PID [--llm-profile LLM_PROFILE]
                        [--replace-image] [--args-json ARGS_JSON]
                        [--preserve-memory | --no-preserve-memory]
                        [--preserve-capabilities] [--run | --no-run]
                        [--max-quanta MAX_QUANTA]
```

### Arguments

| Syntax | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `-h, --help` | no | — | show this help message and exit |
| `image` | yes | `None` | Target AgentImage id, or an image package directory containing IMAGE.yaml. |
| `goal` | yes | `None` | Replacement process goal. |
| `--pid PID` | yes | `None` | Process id to exec. |
| `--llm-profile LLM_PROFILE` | no | `None` | Optional host-selected LLM profile id for the existing process. |
| `--replace-image` | no | `replace_image=False` | Allow an image package to replace an existing image id. |
| `--args-json ARGS_JSON` | no | `'{}'` | JSON object recorded as structured exec args. |
| `--preserve-memory, --no-preserve-memory` | no | `preserve_memory=True` | Keep the current MemoryView across exec. Use --no-preserve-memory to replace it with the new goal only. |
| `--preserve-capabilities` | no | `preserve_capabilities=False` | Keep existing external capabilities. Exec never grants target image required_capabilities automatically. |
| `--run` | no | `run=False` | Run the scheduler after exec. |
| `--no-run` | no | `run=False` | Only apply exec; do not run the scheduler. |
| `--max-quanta MAX_QUANTA` | no | `None` | Optional quantum budget when --run is set; omitted uses runtime.run_until_idle_max_quanta (which may be unbounded). |

## `agent-libos message`

```text
usage: agent-libos message [-h] pid body [--kind {normal,interrupt}] [--interrupt]
                           [--human HUMAN] [--channel CHANNEL] [--subject SUBJECT]
                           [--correlation-id CORRELATION_ID] [--reply-to REPLY_TO]
                           [--payload-json PAYLOAD_JSON] [--run]
                           [--max-quanta MAX_QUANTA]
```

### Arguments

| Syntax | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `-h, --help` | no | — | show this help message and exit |
| `pid` | yes | `None` | Target process id. |
| `body` | yes | `None` | Message body. Quote it to include spaces. |
| `--kind {normal,interrupt}` | no | `'normal'` | — |
| `--interrupt` | no | `interrupt=False` | Shortcut for --kind interrupt. |
| `--human HUMAN` | no | `None` | Human actor name. |
| `--channel CHANNEL` | no | `'human'` | Process-message channel. |
| `--subject SUBJECT` | no | `None` | Short message subject. |
| `--correlation-id CORRELATION_ID` | no | `None` | Optional conversation/request correlation id. |
| `--reply-to REPLY_TO` | no | `None` | Optional message id this message replies to. |
| `--payload-json PAYLOAD_JSON` | no | `'{}'` | Structured JSON object to include in the message payload. |
| `--run` | no | `run=False` | Run the scheduler after posting the message. |
| `--max-quanta MAX_QUANTA` | no | `None` | Optional quantum budget when --run is set; omitted uses runtime.run_until_idle_max_quanta (which may be unbounded). |

## `agent-libos checkpoint`

```text
usage: agent-libos checkpoint [-h] [--actor-pid ACTOR_PID]
                              {create,list,inspect,diff,restore,fork,replay} ...
```

### Arguments

| Syntax | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `-h, --help` | no | — | show this help message and exit |
| `--actor-pid ACTOR_PID` | no | `None` | If set, execute as this process and enforce checkpoint capabilities. Omit for admin CLI mode. |

### Subcommands

| Command | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `create` | Create a checkpoint for a process subtree |
| `list` | List checkpoints |
| `inspect` | Inspect checkpoint metadata |
| `diff` | Diff current reconstructable state against a checkpoint |
| `restore` | Restore checkpoint process subtree |
| `fork` | Fork a new process subtree from a checkpoint |
| `replay` | Return diagnostic event timeline from a checkpoint to an event |

## `agent-libos skills`

```text
usage: agent-libos skills [-h] [--actor-pid ACTOR_PID]
                          {discover,inspect,validate,register,activate,unload,trust,untrust} ...
```

### Arguments

| Syntax | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `-h, --help` | no | — | show this help message and exit |
| `--actor-pid ACTOR_PID` | no | `None` | If set, execute supported subcommands as this process and enforce Skill capabilities. The Host-filesystem 'validate' subcommand rejects this option. Omit for admin CLI mode. |

### Subcommands

| Command | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `discover` | Discover registered skills |
| `inspect` | Inspect a registered skill package |
| `validate` | Validate a standard Agent Skill directory or SKILL.md |
| `register` | Register a standard Agent Skill directory or SKILL.md |
| `activate` | Activate a registered skill in a process |
| `unload` | Unload a skill from a process |
| `trust` | Trust a global Skill package by exact package SHA256 |
| `untrust` | Remove trust for the current bytes of a global Skill package |

## `agent-libos capabilities grant`

```text
usage: agent-libos capabilities grant [-h] subject resource
                                      --rights {read,write,execute,link,diff,materialize,delete,grant,revoke,approve,admin} [{read,write,execute,link,diff,materialize,delete,grant,revoke,approve,admin} ...]
                                      [--effect {allow,deny,ask}] [--delegable]
                                      [--revocable | --no-revocable]
                                      [--uses-remaining USES_REMAINING]
                                      [--expires-at EXPIRES_AT]
                                      [--constraints-json CONSTRAINTS_JSON]
                                      [--metadata-json METADATA_JSON]
```

### Arguments

| Syntax | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `-h, --help` | no | — | show this help message and exit |
| `subject` | yes | `None` | — |
| `resource` | yes | `None` | — |

## `agent-libos mcp`

```text
usage: agent-libos mcp [-h] [--actor-pid ACTOR_PID]
                       [--oauth-profile-file OAUTH_PROFILE_FILE]
                       [--oauth-client-secret-fd OAUTH_CLIENT_SECRET_FD]
                       {register,list,inspect,discover,tools,call,unregister,resources,prompts,auth,continuations,remote-tasks,subscriptions,validate,doctor,probe,scaffold,export,import} ...
```

### Arguments

| Syntax | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `-h, --help` | no | — | show this help message and exit |
| `--actor-pid ACTOR_PID` | no | `None` | If set, execute registry operations as this process and enforce MCP server capabilities. |
| `--oauth-profile-file OAUTH_PROFILE_FILE` | no | `None` | Bounded strict Host OAuth profile JSON to bind or rehydrate before this command. Place this option before the MCP subcommand. |
| `--oauth-client-secret-fd OAUTH_CLIENT_SECRET_FD` | no | `None` | Read a bounded OAuth client secret from this already-open fd (fd >= 3) while binding --oauth-profile-file; never accepts a secret in argv. |

### Subcommands

| Command | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `register` | Register an MCP server manifest from YAML or JSON |
| `list` | List registered MCP server metadata |
| `inspect` | Inspect one registered MCP server |
| `discover` | Negotiate and inspect one registered modern MCP server |
| `tools` | List allowed tools for one registered MCP server |
| `call` | Call a registered MCP tool as a process |
| `unregister` | Delete a registered MCP server |
| `resources` | Host-only Resource and Resource Template operations for Manifest v3 servers |
| `prompts` | Host-only Prompt preview and Completion operations |
| `auth` | Host-only OAuth lifecycle for configured credential profiles (DCR unsupported) |
| `continuations` | Host-only inspection and single-use response of local Elicitation continuations |
| `remote-tasks` | Host-only operations on a local remote-task reference (no remote tasks/list) |
| `subscriptions` | Host-only foreground subscriptions/listen; events never trigger automatic actions |
| `validate` | Offline-validate a manifest without provider effects |
| `doctor` | Check a manifest, dependencies and named environment references offline |
| `probe` | Collect all four catalogs from an unregistered v3 candidate through the governed primitive |
| `scaffold` | Create or approve a conservative Host-reviewed manifest candidate |
| `export` | Export canonical manifests with references but never secret values |
| `import` | Plan or CAS-apply a bounded registry export |

## `agent-libos store migrate`

```text
usage: agent-libos store migrate [-h] --to {5,6,7} (--dry-run | --apply)
                                 [--expected-plan-sha256 EXPECTED_PLAN_SHA256]
                                 [--sqlite-backup SQLITE_BACKUP]
                                 [--postgres-snapshot-confirmed]
```

### Arguments

| Syntax | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `-h, --help` | no | — | show this help message and exit |
| `--to {5,6,7}` | yes | `None` | Target offline Runtime store schema version to plan or apply a migration to. |
| `--dry-run` | no | `dry_run=False` | Validate and print the canonical migration plan without writing. |
| `--apply` | no | `apply=False` | Apply the canonical plan after verifying its digest and backup evidence. |
| `--expected-plan-sha256 EXPECTED_PLAN_SHA256` | no | `None` | Exact plan digest printed by a prior --dry-run; required with --apply. |
| `--sqlite-backup SQLITE_BACKUP` | no | `None` | Existing verified SQLite backup required before applying a SQLite migration. |
| `--postgres-snapshot-confirmed` | no | `postgres_snapshot_confirmed=False` | Confirm an operator snapshot exists before applying a PostgreSQL migration. |
